citation: Hirschberg et al. (1998), Journal of General Physiology 111, 565–581, Figures 1B and 13A
dose_context: Absolute single-channel open probability over 30–60 s in one inside-out patch from a Xenopus oocyte expressing rat SK2, nominally −80 mV. The 5 µM solution shifted the voltage by about 11 mV.
digitization: Figure 1B, 720 × 899 raster, pixel origin at top left. Horizontal calibration x = 157.91 + 64.125 × free calcium in µM. Vertical calibration y = 846.57 − 253.14 × open probability. Approximate marker centers (196.6,768.6), (209.6,730.8), (222.2,713.5), (478.0,641.5). The authors give the nominal doses. Two readings agreed within 0.01 in open probability.
jump_context: Macroscopic current in separate inside-out patches from the same expression system at −80 mV. Six calcium jumps in two patches. The pooled times are mean ± SD. The rise and washout in Figure 13A are experimental; the model traces in Figure 13B are excluded.
